every.description: Mark every nth beat of the visible part, from the first; default 1.

item_id.description: An audio item of an audio asset, or of a video asset with audio.

label.description: Label of every marker, up to 60 characters; default none.

replace.description: true (default) replaces the item's markers; false keeps them and adds the beats.

resolved.description: Filled by the service from the beat grid of the asset; never sent by a caller.

beats.description: Strictly increasing beat positions in asset frames, from 0.
